purpose: Validate Submit Complaint main success flow
preconditions: User / Complainant is an authorized CMS user; mandatory fields and attachment constraints are available to CMS.
action_or_input: 1. User / Complainant opens the complaint submission function. | 2. Enters complaint category/type, complaint description, and other mandatory complaint information. | 3. Attaches supporting evidence if applicable. | 4. CMS validates mandatory complaint fields. | 5. CMS validates accepted attachment constraints. | 6. CMS accepts the submission, records submission date/time, and generates a unique complaint identifier. | 7. CMS provides submission confirmation and triggers the complaint-submission email notification event.
expected_result: Complaint is registered with identifier, category/type, description, submission date/time, and submission confirmation/notification event recorded.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Submit Complaint
preconditions: User / Complainant is an authorized CMS user; mandatory fields and attachment constraints are available to CMS.
action_or_input: - If mandatory fields are incomplete, CMS does not accept the submission and asks the User / Complainant to correct the submission.
expected_result: Submission or attachment is not accepted as specified; no accepted record is created for a rejected submission.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Submit Complaint
preconditions: User / Complainant is an authorized CMS user; mandatory fields and attachment constraints are available to CMS.
action_or_input: If an attachment violates accepted constraints, Field Content CMS does not accept the attachment until corrected or removed.
expected_result: Attachment is not accepted until corrected or removed.

purpose: Validate Track Submitted Complaint Status and History main success flow
preconditions: At least one complaint submitted by the User / Complainant exists in CMS.
action_or_input: 1. User / Complainant opens complaint tracking. | 2. CMS lists the User / Complainant's submitted complaints. | 3. User / Complainant selects a complaint. | 4. CMS displays current complaint status and complaint history for the selected complaint.
expected_result: User / Complainant has viewed status/history information; no lifecycle state is changed.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Track Submitted Complaint Status and History
preconditions: At least one complaint submitted by the User / Complainant exists in CMS.
action_or_input: - If no submitted complaint exists, CMS shows that there is no complaint history for the User / Complainant.
expected_result: If no submitted complaint exists, CMS shows that there is no complaint history for the User / Complainant.

purpose: Validate Review Assigned Complaints main success flow
preconditions: Complaint Handler role is active and assigned complaints exist or may exist.
action_or_input: 1. Complaint Handler opens assigned complaints list. | 2. CMS displays complaints assigned for handling. | 3. Complaint Handler reviews complaint details, status, history, assignment, priority, and available attachments where present. Field Content
expected_result: Complaint Handler has reviewed assigned complaint information; no state change is required by this use case.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Review Assigned Complaints
preconditions: Complaint Handler role is active and assigned complaints exist or may exist.
action_or_input: - If no assigned complaints exist, CMS shows an empty assigned-complaint list.
expected_result: If no assigned complaints exist, CMS shows an empty assigned-complaint list.

purpose: Validate Assign, Categorize, and Prioritize Complaint main success flow
preconditions: A submitted complaint exists and the Complaint Handler role is active.
action_or_input: 1. Complaint Handler selects a submitted complaint. | 2. Complaint Handler manually assigns the complaint for operational handling. | 3. Complaint Handler categorizes the complaint by complaint category/type. | 4. Complaint Handler assigns priority as Low, Medium, or High. | 5. CMS records assignment and priority information for downstream handling, reminders, and escalation.
expected_result: Complaint has assignment, category/type, and priority information recorded for handling, reminders, and escalation.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Assign, Categorize, and Prioritize Complaint
preconditions: A submitted complaint exists and the Complaint Handler role is active.
action_or_input: - If required assignment, category/type, or priority information is not supplied, CMS keeps the complaint from completing this operation until corrected.
expected_result: If required assignment, category/type, or priority information is not supplied, CMS keeps the complaint from completing this operation until corrected.

purpose: Validate Update Complaint Progress main success flow
preconditions: Complaint is assigned for handling and is within the complaint lifecycle.
action_or_input: 1. Complaint Handler opens the complaint. | 2. Complaint Handler enters a progress update. | 3. CMS records the Field Content progress update and maintains progress history. | 4. CMS triggers a status-update notification only where an independently supported status update event applies.
expected_result: Complaint progress history is updated. No generic lifecycle-state change is inferred from a progress entry.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Update Complaint Progress
preconditions: Complaint is assigned for handling and is within the complaint lifecycle.
action_or_input: - If the progress update is incomplete or invalid for the current state, CMS does not record the update until corrected.
expected_result: If the progress update is incomplete or invalid for the current state, CMS does not record the update until corrected.

purpose: Validate Resolve or Reject Complaint main success flow
preconditions: Complaint is assigned for handling and is not already closed.
action_or_input: 1. Complaint Handler opens the complaint. | 2. Selects Resolution or Rejection. | 3. For Resolution, records resolution details. | 4. For Rejection, records rejection details/reason. | 5. CMS updates status to Resolved or Rejected according to the supported outcome. | 6. CMS records the outcome/status update and triggers the corresponding resolution or rejection email notification event.
expected_result: Complaint outcome and status are recorded; User / Complainant is notified.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Resolve or Reject Complaint
preconditions: Complaint is assigned for handling and is not already closed.
action_or_input: - If resolution details are missing for a resolved complaint, CMS does not mark the complaint Resolved.
expected_result: If resolution details are missing for a resolved complaint, CMS does not mark the complaint Resolved.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Resolve or Reject Complaint
preconditions: Complaint is assigned for handling and is not already closed.
action_or_input: If rejection details or reason information are missing for a rejected complaint, CMS does not mark the complaint Rejected.
expected_result: If rejection details or reason information are missing for a rejected complaint, CMS does not mark the complaint Rejected.

purpose: Validate Verify Resolved Complaint for Closure (User / Complainant) main success flow
preconditions: Complaint is Resolved; applicable closure process identifies User / Complainant verification.
action_or_input: 1. User / Complainant opens the resolved complaint. | 2. Reviews resolution details. | 3. Records successful verification. | 4. CMS records closure and updates status to Closed.
expected_result: Resolved complaint is Closed after successful required User / Complainant verification.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Verify Resolved Complaint for Closure (User / Complainant)
preconditions: Complaint is Resolved; applicable closure process identifies User / Complainant verification.
action_or_input: If verification is not recorded/successful, CMS does not close the complaint under this verification-required path.
expected_result: If verification is not recorded/successful, CMS does not close the complaint under this verification-required path.

purpose: Validate Request Complaint Reopening main success flow
preconditions: Complaint is Closed and belongs to the User / Complainant.
action_or_input: 1. User / Complainant opens the closed complaint. | 2. Submits a reopening request. | 3. CMS records the reopening request and makes it available for Complaint Supervisor review.
expected_result: A reopening request is recorded while the complaint remains Closed pending review.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Request Complaint Reopening
preconditions: Complaint is Closed and belongs to the User / Complainant.
action_or_input: If the complaint is not Closed, CMS does not process the action as a reopening request.
expected_result: If the complaint is not Closed, CMS does not process the action as a reopening request.

purpose: Validate Submit Feedback main success flow
preconditions: Complaint is resolved or closed.
action_or_input: 1. User / Complainant opens feedback submission. | 2. Enters feedback. | 3. CMS records feedback for authorized review. | 4. CMS triggers a feedback-related email notification event where applicable.
expected_result: Feedback is stored and available to authorized reviewers.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Submit Feedback
preconditions: Complaint is resolved or closed.
action_or_input: - If the complaint is neither resolved nor closed, CMS does not treat the feedback as post-resolution/closure feedback.
expected_result: If the complaint is neither resolved nor closed, CMS does not treat the feedback as post-resolution/closure feedback.

purpose: Validate Review Submitted Feedback main success flow
preconditions: Submitted feedback exists.
action_or_input: 1. Actor opens feedback review function. | 2. CMS displays submitted feedback. | 3. Actor reviews feedback content.
expected_result: Feedback is reviewed; no complaint lifecycle transition is implied.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Review Submitted Feedback
preconditions: Submitted feedback exists.
action_or_input: - If no feedback exists, CMS shows an empty feedback list.
expected_result: If no feedback exists, CMS shows an empty feedback list.

purpose: Validate Manually Escalate Unresolved Complaint main success flow
preconditions: Complaint remains unresolved and is within active handling.
action_or_input: 1. Complaint Handler opens an unresolved complaint. | 2. Initiates manual escalation. | 3. CMS records escalation status. | 4. CMS triggers the complaint-escalation email notification event. Field Content
expected_result: Complaint escalation status is recorded.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Manually Escalate Unresolved Complaint
preconditions: Complaint remains unresolved and is within active handling.
action_or_input: - If the complaint is already resolved, rejected, or closed, CMS does not treat it as an unresolved complaint for manual escalation.
expected_result: If the complaint is already resolved, rejected, or closed, CMS does not treat it as an unresolved complaint for manual escalation.

purpose: Validate Monitor Escalated Complaints main success flow
preconditions: One or more complaints may have recorded escalation status; Complaint Supervisor role is active.
action_or_input: 1. Complaint Supervisor opens escalated-complaint monitoring. | 2. CMS displays escalated complaints and their recorded escalation status. | 3. Complaint Supervisor reviews the displayed escalation information.
expected_result: Complaint Supervisor has reviewed escalated complaint information; no complaint lifecycle or escalation state is changed by this use case.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Monitor Escalated Complaints
preconditions: One or more complaints may have recorded escalation status; Complaint Supervisor role is active.
action_or_input: - If no escalated complaints exist, CMS shows no escalated complaint entries.
expected_result: If no escalated complaints exist, CMS shows no escalated complaint entries.

purpose: Validate Publish Complaint-Related Announcement main success flow
preconditions: Actor is an active Complaint Handler or Complaint Supervisor.
action_or_input: 1. Authorized Complaint Handler or Complaint Supervisor opens announcement publishing. | 2. Enters complaint-related announcement content. | 3. CMS publishes the announcement. | 4. CMS triggers the announcement-related Field Content email notification event where CMS is configured to notify Users / Complainants.
expected_result: Announcement is published and notification may be triggered according to CMS configuration.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Publish Complaint-Related Announcement
preconditions: Actor is an active Complaint Handler or Complaint Supervisor.
action_or_input: - If actor is not Complaint Handler or Complaint Supervisor, CMS does not allow announcement publication.
expected_result: If actor is not Complaint Handler or Complaint Supervisor, CMS does not allow announcement publication.

purpose: Validate View Complaint-Related Announcements main success flow
preconditions: User / Complainant has access to CMS.
action_or_input: 1. User / Complainant opens announcement view. | 2. CMS displays complaint-related announcements.
expected_result: User / Complainant has viewed announcements.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for View Complaint-Related Announcements
preconditions: User / Complainant has access to CMS.
action_or_input: - If no announcement exists, CMS shows no announcement entries.
expected_result: If no announcement exists, CMS shows no announcement entries.

purpose: Validate Generate Operational Complaint Reports main success flow
preconditions: Complaint Handler role is active.
action_or_input: 1. Complaint Handler opens reporting function. | 2. Complaint Handler selects operational report parameters available within CMS. | 3. CMS generates the operational complaint report.
expected_result: Operational complaint report is available to Complaint Handler. Field Content

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Generate Operational Complaint Reports
preconditions: Complaint Handler role is active.
action_or_input: - If no data matches selected parameters, CMS generates an empty/no-data result.
expected_result: If no data matches selected parameters, CMS generates an empty/no-data result.

purpose: Validate View Complaint and Escalation Summaries main success flow
preconditions: Complaint Supervisor role is active.
action_or_input: 1. Complaint Supervisor opens complaint summary view. | 2. CMS displays complaint summaries. | 3. Complaint Supervisor opens escalation summary view. | 4. CMS displays escalation summaries.
expected_result: Complaint Supervisor has viewed available summaries.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for View Complaint and Escalation Summaries
preconditions: Complaint Supervisor role is active.
action_or_input: - If no data exists, CMS displays empty/no-data summary.
expected_result: If no data exists, CMS displays empty/no-data summary.

purpose: Validate View CMS Reports and Analytics main success flow
preconditions: System Admin role is active.
action_or_input: 1. System Admin opens CMS reporting/analytics view. | 2. CMS displays complaint reports available within CMS. | 3. CMS displays analytics available within CMS.
expected_result: System Admin has viewed reports/analytics available within CMS; no routine complaint operation is performed.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for View CMS Reports and Analytics
preconditions: System Admin role is active.
action_or_input: - If analytics/report data is unavailable, CMS displays empty/no-data result.
expected_result: If analytics/report data is unavailable, CMS displays empty/no-data result.

purpose: Validate Manage CMS Roles main success flow
preconditions: Target institutional users exist outside CMS; CMS role-management function is available.
action_or_input: 1. System Admin selects an existing institutional user for Complaint Handler role assignment and specified duration. | 2. System Admin selects an existing institutional user for Complaint Supervisor role assignment and specified duration. | 3. System Admin performs mid-cycle reassignment when required. | 4. CMS enforces exactly one active Complaint Handler and exactly one active Complaint Supervisor role-holder at a time within CMS.
expected_result: CMS-specific Complaint Handler and Complaint Supervisor role assignments are recorded for specified duration.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Manage CMS Roles
preconditions: Target institutional users exist outside CMS; CMS role-management function is available.
action_or_input: - If assignment would violate active-role cardinality, CMS does not complete the role assignment until corrected.
expected_result: If assignment would violate active-role cardinality, CMS does not complete the role assignment until corrected.

purpose: Validate Verify Resolved Complaint for Closure (Complaint main success flow
preconditions: Complaint is Resolved; applicable closure process identifies Complaint Supervisor verification.
action_or_input: 1. Complaint Supervisor opens the resolved complaint. | 2. Reviews resolution details. | 3. Records successful verification. | 4. CMS records closure and updates status to Closed.
expected_result: Resolved complaint is Closed after successful required Complaint Supervisor verification.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Verify Resolved Complaint for Closure (Complaint
preconditions: Complaint is Resolved; applicable closure process identifies Complaint Supervisor verification.
action_or_input: If verification is not recorded/successful, CMS does not close the complaint under this verification-required path.
expected_result: If verification is not recorded/successful, CMS does not close the complaint under this verification-required path.

purpose: Validate Review Complaint Reopening Request main success flow
preconditions: Complaint is Closed; a valid reopening request is recorded.
action_or_input: 1. Complaint Supervisor opens the reopening request. | 2. Reviews the request. | 3. Records approval or denial. | 4. CMS records the reopening outcome. | 5. If approved, CMS reopens the complaint and updates status accordingly. | 6. CMS triggers the reopening-outcome email notification event where applicable.
expected_result: Outcome is recorded; denied complaints remain Closed; approved complaints are reopened with status updated according to policy.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Review Complaint Reopening Request
preconditions: Complaint is Closed; a valid reopening request is recorded.
action_or_input: If denied, the complaint remains Closed and the denial outcome is recorded.
expected_result: If denied, the complaint remains Closed and the denial outcome is recorded.

purpose: Validate Trigger Pre-Breach SLA Reminder main success flow
preconditions: Complaint remains unresolved; complaint priority is associated with an applicable SLA timeline; applicable SLA values are available to CMS but are not specified in this baseline.
action_or_input: 1. The configured time/SLA condition is reached for an unresolved complaint. | 2. CMS evaluates the complaint against its applicable priority-SLA association. | 3. CMS triggers the pre-breach reminder notification event.
expected_result: The reminder notification trigger has been issued; complaint lifecycle and escalation status are unchanged by this use case.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Trigger Pre-Breach SLA Reminder
preconditions: Complaint remains unresolved; complaint priority is associated with an applicable SLA timeline; applicable SLA values are available to CMS but are not specified in this baseline.
action_or_input: - If the complaint is already resolved, no pre-breach reminder is triggered for that resolved complaint.
expected_result: If the complaint is already resolved, no pre-breach reminder is triggered for that resolved complaint.

purpose: Validate Automatically Escalate Complaint on SLA Breach main success flow
preconditions: Complaint remains unresolved; complaint priority is associated with an applicable SLA timeline; complaint has not already been escalated for the same active condition.
action_or_input: 1. The applicable SLA breach condition occurs while the complaint remains unresolved. | 2. CMS evaluates the complaint against the applicable SLA condition. | 3. CMS records automatic escalation and updates escalation status. | 4. CMS triggers the complaint-escalation email notification event.
expected_result: Complaint escalation status records automatic escalation; the escalated complaint is available for Complaint Supervisor monitoring.

purpose: Validate documented alternative for Automatically Escalate Complaint on SLA Breach
preconditions: Complaint remains unresolved; complaint priority is associated with an applicable SLA timeline; complaint has not already been escalated for the same active condition.
action_or_input: - If the complaint has been resolved before the breach condition is processed, automatic escalation is not performed.
expected_result: If the complaint has been resolved before the breach condition is processed, automatic escalation is not performed.
